name: GT2 timing belt, 6 mm wide, 2 m
source: https://www.reprap.org/wiki/GT2_belt and Gates PowerGrip GT2 profile (2 mm pitch, 6 mm wide, 1.38 mm thick)
notes: Open-ended GT2 belt, 2 mm pitch, 6 mm wide, teeth on one side, laid straight along X (teeth facing -z). Cut to length: 20T pulley = 40 mm of belt per turn. Fits gt2-pulley-20t-5mm and gt2-idler-20t-5mm. CoreXY / plotter: clamp both ends to the carriage.

appearance.source: typical black rubber belt with glass fibre core
